component.name: XerahS
component.summary: Cross-platform screen capture and sharing tool

description.p: XerahS is a modern, cross-platform screen capture and file-sharing application. It supports full-screen, window, and region screenshots, screen recordings, animated GIFs, and integrates with dozens of upload destinations including cloud storage, image hosts, and custom uploaders.

ul.li: Full-screen, window, and custom region capture
Screen recording and animated GIF creation
Built-in image editor with annotations and effects
Video editor with timeline-based cutting and watermarking
Global hotkeys and system tray integration
30+ upload destinations (Imgur, S3, FTP, custom scripts, and more)

description.p: On GNOME, install the gnome-shell-extension-appindicator package to enable the system tray icon (Settings → Appearance → Show tray icon).
See the full changelog on GitHub.
